minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  February 25, 2020

1. A regular meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by
  Mayor Don Kendrick at 6:30 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Don Kendrick, Chair
  Robin Carder, Council Member
  Matthew Lyons, BUSD
  Carolyn Cockrell, BUSD
  Denise Fisher, Resident

  Mark Rodgers, BUSD
  Michael Gaydos, Student Representative
  Jason Lorge, Resident
  Ron Serven, Resident
  Mark Fulgenzi, LV Bike Coalition
  Jessica Vozella, American Lung Association
  Dexter Sapien, American Lung Association
  Marissa Scholefield, David & Margaret
  Michael Miller, David & Margaret
  Sam Gonzalez, LVPD
  Hollie Savage, LVPD
  David Yim, Tri-City
  Isela Moreno, Tri-City
  Bill Aguirre, City of La Verne
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne

3. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the January 28th meeting were approved.

4.  School Resource Officer  Administrative Lieutenant Sam Gonzalez reported
  that the new School Resource Officer (SRO) would
  be Janessa Gonzalez and that she would begin
  transitioning with outgoing SRO Frankie Cambero
  toward the end of the year. The group discussed
  youth and mental health issues in the community as
  well as available resources for helping.

5. Budget Update  Bill Aguirre with the City of La Verne shared a report
  on YFAC’s current funding status. Bill noted that it
  may be time to begin considering a fundraiser to
  generate revenue for programs. Bill shared it had
  been several years since the last effort because of
  generous donations from community sources.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes February 25, 2020, page 2

6. Teen Center  Bill provided a history on efforts to build a Teen Center
  in La Verne as well as an update on today’s status.
  Bill shared he hopes to work on securing grant funding
  for a large portion of the costs to build the center and
  that funding would be crucial for the project to become
  a realization.

7. Parent Tips  JR Ranells with the City of La Verne provided
  information on the YFAC social media platforms. The
  group discussed generating regular posts each week
  on parenting tips including posts on healthy living,
  general wellness, as well as focusing on suicide
  prevention. Other ideas included a YFAC meeting re-
  cap, vaping issues, and education on
  appropriate/inappropriate social media usage.

8. Round Table  Mark Fulgenzi with the LV Bicycle Coalition shared
  that their upcoming meeting will be held on March 18th.
  Mark also shared information on Open Streets on April
  19th and Ride to Work Day on May 14th.

  Lt. Gonzalez shared input on checking in with children
  regarding mental health.

  Matt Lyons with the BUSD shared information on the
  State of the District. He noted he is a happy parent
  and BUSD Board Member and complimented the
  professionalism of the La Verne Police Department.

  Isela Moreno with Tri-City Mental Health shared
  information on the Homeless Navigator. She also
  shared information on the upcoming Green Ribbon
  Week taking place the week of March 16th.

  Marissa Scholefield with David & Margaret shared
  information on programs and resources available as
  well as a new drop in center.

  Resident Ron Serven encouraged the group to
  broaden their awareness and wellness.

  Mayor Kendrick shared his appreciation for everyone’s
  participation and that he hopes the group will continue
  to work to make La Verne the best it can be.

9.  Public Comment  None
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes February 25, 2020, page 3

10.  Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting is scheduled for March 23rd
  at 6:30 p.m.

11. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:56 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Personnel Officer
